name: 크랩
scene: On a deserted dry red-rock tidal promenade in clear morning light, stable upright card pose facing camera, both empty hands relaxed open outside her silhouette, head and boots fully visible.
casual: At a shallow rocky tidal survey area at noon, crouching on a broad dry rock and placing a smooth shell onto a wide sample tray between both separated hands, face readable, complete body and boots visible. Pale tide pools and weathered red rocks.
Opaque coral-red sleeveless utility jumpsuit with short legs, secure front zip and cream waist belt, rubber ankle boots. Bare shoulders arms and legs, tiny shell-shaped earrings.

At a bright harbor citrus-preserve kitchen at early morning, presenting two small glazed fruit tarts on a broad cream platter held at opposite edges with both hands. Open window toward sea and copper pots, no text.
Opaque cream off-shoulder wrap blouse with secure folded neckline, coral high-waisted skirt below crop and short tan waist apron. Bare shoulders arms and waist gap, tiny shell pendant.

At an empty seaside shower pavilion after sunset, kneeling comfortably on a dry wooden mat while shaking sand from a folded towel held between both hands at hip level. Warm coral lamps and distant blue surf; face and both complete hands visible.

Fully lined coral-red asymmetrical one-piece swimsuit with secure broad single shoulder strap, cream side panel, modest diagonal waist opening and full pelvis coverage; a sheer cream sarong draped loose over one hip. Bare arms shoulders waist opening and legs, tiny shell anklet.
